g.aria-label: How Router Weights W_r Learn Through Discrete Top-k Selection
If g_e = p_e / ∑_(j ∈ T₁) p_j = p_e / p_e ≡ 1
Rule: Never Renormalize Top-1 Router Probabilities
In Top-1 routing (Switch Transformer), multiplying by the raw softmax probability p_(e*)(x)
is the ONLY path for task-loss gradients to update the router matrix W_r!
